summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Avantis Inflation Focused Equity ETF (AVIE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed equity fund of US companies involved in sectors or industries that tend to outperform during periods of inflation. AVIE was launched on Sep 27, 2022 and is issued by American Century Investments.

holdings.infoBox: AVIE is an equity ETF with a total of 364 individual holdings. The top holdings are Berkshire Hathaway stock at 5.23%, ExxonMobil Holdings at 5.03%, The Procter & Gamble Company at 3.58%, Eli Lilly and Company at 3.58%, and Chevron at 3.04%.
